subject: Future Tech
title: Grover's Search Speedup
description: A 60-second lesson on Grover's Search Speedup.

hook.text: Searching an unsorted list of a million items classically takes a million checks. Grover does it in a thousand.

buildup.text: Lov Grover published his algorithm in 1996. It gives a quadratic speedup for any unstructured search problem.

discovery.text: The trick: amplify the probability of the correct answer while suppressing wrong ones through interference.

twist.text: A quadratic speedup sounds modest, but for huge datasets it turns centuries of computation into hours.

climax.text: Grover's method also boosts optimization and AI tasks where searching possibilities is the main bottleneck.

punchline.text: Grover asks the haystack to hand over the needle.

quiz.question: What kind of speedup does Grover's algorithm provide?
